close_reason: Epic complete: all three profile functions implemented (web_pki_policy, smime_policy, code_signing_policy). ValidationPolicy extended with 5 enforcement fields. Full workspace tests green.
description:
The three CA/B Forum profile functions in pkix-profiles — web_pki_policy, smime_policy, code_signing_policy — all panic with unimplemented!(). Only rfc5280_policy is real (it just calls ValidationPolicy::new()).

Completing these requires two phases:

Phase 1: Extend ValidationPolicy in pkix-path to carry the additional constraints the profiles need (max validity period, allowed signature algorithm OIDs, minimum RSA key size, required extensions). These fields are not present today.

Phase 2: Implement each profile function to return a ValidationPolicy with those fields populated per the relevant CA/B Forum Baseline Requirements document.

Acceptance criteria:
- web_pki_policy, smime_policy, and code_signing_policy return real ValidationPolicy values (no panic)
- The constraints they set are enforced by validate_path / chain_walk
- Tests verify that certificates violating each profile's constraints are rejected
- cargo test --workspace passes
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg docsrs -D warnings' cargo +nightly doc --no-deps --all-features --workspace passes
- cargo +1.73 check --workspace passes
title: Epic: implement pkix-profiles (CA/B Forum policy functions)
